record.one_liner: Slack provides Web APIs, Events APIs, and an MCP server for building apps and integrations that read, write, and manage workspace data.

auth_methods.quote: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow. Your app can act with its own identity instead of acting on behalf of users... At the end of the OAuth flow, your app gains an access token.

access_test.quote: No approval yet? Try it in a free Developer Program sandbox.

access_ship.quote: OAuth allows a user in any Slack workspace to install your app.

api_type.quote: The Web API supplies a collection of HTTP methods that underpin the majority of Slack app functionality.

api_breadth.quote: With over 100 methods available, it's impossible to explain everything that's possible with the Web API, but we're sure there's one right for your app.

official_mcp.quote: One install adds the Slack developer skills, plus the Slack MCP server in Claude Code and Cursor.
